ontop_gnome: Your desktop decides which windows stay on top, and apps can't ask for it. To keep this one above the others, press Alt+Space and choose “Always on Top”.
ontop_kde: Your desktop decides which windows stay on top, and apps can't ask for it. To keep this one above the others, press Alt+F3 and choose “More Actions”, then “Keep Above Others”.
ontop_other: Your desktop decides which windows stay on top, and apps can't ask for it. Its window settings may have a way to keep a window above the others.
